name: Tsuki ni Konban wa!
source:
While you were watching the moon, a girl called Luna came falling down.
It turned out she is the queen of the moon, and she moved in with you. 
Your life together is about to start.

This is a love comedy about living together with a girl who fell down from the moon.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE199594.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你正在看月亮时，一个名叫露娜的女孩从天而降。
结果发现她是月亮女王，并搬来与你同住。
你们共同生活的日子就此开始。

这是一个与从月亮坠落的女孩同居的恋爱喜剧。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE199594.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
